# Prep

```{r}
rm(list=ls())
```


```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

files <- list.files("/path/to/project/results/bam_files/final_bams/hg38/insert_size_dist", pattern = "_insert_size_metrics.txt$", full.names = TRUE)

read_hist <- function(f) {
  lines <- readLines(f)
  start <- grep("^## HISTOGRAM", lines) + 1
  h <- read.delim(text = lines[start:length(lines)], check.names = FALSE)
  h <- h[!is.na(h[[1]]), ]
  data.frame(
    sample      = sub("_insert_size_metrics.txt$", "", basename(f)),
    insert_size = h[[1]],
    count       = rowSums(h[, -1, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)  # sums FR/RF/tandem columns if present
  )
}
df <- bind_rows(lapply(files, read_hist))

df$sample <- sub("-native_S.*$", "", df$sample)

# Original order (alphabetical on the full names, as ggplot did before)
orig_levels <- sort(unique(df$sample))

# Remove everything before and including "MCF7-Par", plus any leftover leading - or _
strip_prefix <- function(x) sub("^.*MCF7-Par[-_]*", "", x)

df$sample <- factor(strip_prefix(df$sample), levels = strip_prefix(orig_levels))

df <- df %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  mutate(prop = count / sum(count)) %>%
  ungroup()

p <- ggplot(df, aes(insert_size, prop, colour = sample)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.6) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 800)) +
  labs(x = "Fragment length (bp)", y = "Proportion of fragments") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.title   = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.text    = element_text(size = 15),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 15),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.position = "inside",
    legend.position.inside = c(0.98, 0.98),
    legend.justification = c(1, 1),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.8), colour = "grey70")
  )

ggsave("insert_size_all_samples.png", p, width = 9, height = 5)
```
